claims.claim_text: RA 8293 protects works of architecture and plans, sketches, charts, and three-dimensional works relative to architecture by the sole fact of creation.
RA 8293 protects expression but not ideas, procedures, systems, methods, concepts, principles, discoveries, or mere data as such.
RA 8293 Section 186 gives an architecture-specific erection-control right with a reconstruction/rehabilitation-in-same-style limit.
RA 9266 IRR Section 33 requires written consent to duplicate signed/sealed architectural documents for repetition or other projects.
Question edits staged locally for 10 linked questions.
